product.title: Kyoto: Nijo, Kinkaku-ji, Arashiyama, Kiyomizu & Fushimi Inari

description.text: In Kyoto, this guided coach day leaves Hotel Keihan Kyoto Grande for a published ten-hour circuit of Arashiyama Bamboo Forest, Kinkaku-ji, Nijo Castle, Kiyomizu-dera Temple, and Fushimi Inari-taisha Shrine. Ticket-inclusive or ticket-excluded packages are listed so admission at the Golden Pavilion, Kiyomizu-dera, and Nijo Castle can be added or left separate. The tour ends at Fushimi Inari-taisha, with directions back to Kyoto Station given on site. Arrive at least ten minutes before departure. The format suits visitors who want a coordinated five-stop day without assembling coach and ticket timing independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Kyoto, and the itinerary stays on Arashiyama, Kinkaku-ji, Nijo Castle, Kiyomizu-dera, and Fushimi Inari that define this outing rather than a private walking custom day.

highlights: Full-day coach circuit of five published Kyoto landmarks
Arashiyama bamboo, Kinkaku-ji, Nijo Castle, Kiyomizu-dera, and Fushimi Inari
Meet at Hotel Keihan Kyoto Grande

start.description: Meet the guide outside Hotel Keihan Kyoto Grande. The guide waits with an Amigo Tours sign. Arrive at least 10 minutes before departure. The tour ends at Fushimi Inari-taisha.

end.description: Return to your Kyoto meeting point after the final stop on the itinerary.
